title: Make native chat safe to use while an agent is already working
description:
Sending from native chat while an agent is busy has failure modes that nothing covers today. The Disable Reloads button made them easy to reach, because a working agent is what reloads the page.

Observed problems:
- A delivered Claude Code message can be reported as failed.
- Reloads bring the notice back, so a second click sends the request twice.
- A chat with no attached session starts a second agent beside a busy one.
- Agents that devhost did not start are invisible to it.

Evidence, experiments and sources: `wiki/research/headless-agent-cli-message-delivery.md` in the ai-registry repository. Experiments ran against Claude Code 2.1.310.

The agent-watcher and agent-parser tasks are changes to those libraries, tracked here because devhost is the consumer.
